working_memory.text: The Ravensholme choir will travel by coach to Bruges in June for three concerts, its first tour abroad since the group was founded twelve years ago. The programme mixes English folk arrangements with two pieces written for the choir by a local composer. Members are paying their own travel costs, and the choir has sold tea-towels and a recording to cover hall hire. Rehearsals have moved to twice a week until the tour. A homecoming concert is planned for the village hall.
